RadioButton.title: Radio button
RadioButton.description: One option of a radio group.

RadioGroup.title: Radio group
RadioGroup.description: Single choice from a few options, drawn as a segmented control.

DiscreteSlider.title: Discrete-value slider
DiscreteSlider.description: Slider over a fixed list of values such as 1, 2, 4, 8.

PasswordInput.title: Password input
PasswordInput.description: Text input with a show/hide button.

BottomButtons.title: Bottom button row
BottomButtons.description: Row of dialog buttons with standard padding.

LabelValueField.title: Label and value field
LabelValueField.description: Read-only label and value row, for example Version 1.2.3.

LoadingThrobber.title: Loading throbber
LoadingThrobber.description: Circular loading indicator in several sizes.

SegmentedCharacterInput.title: Segmented character input
SegmentedCharacterInput.description: Code entry with one box per character.

CompoundSlider.title: Compound slider
CompoundSlider.description: Multi-handle or grouped sub-slider control for range or paired settings.

DialogTwoButton.title: Dialog two-button bar
DialogTwoButton.description: Standard Steam OK and Cancel modal button row.

DialogThreeButton.title: Dialog three-button bar
DialogThreeButton.description: Three-action modal button row with Confirm, Update, and Cancel buttons.

DropDownControlButton.title: Dropdown control button

DialogReorderableList.title: Dialog reorderable list

PagedSettings.title: Paged settings
PagedSettings.description: Multi-page Steam settings layout with left navigation list and optional bottom controls.

GamepadPage.title: Gamepad page
GamepadPage.description: Full-screen Steam Deck page wrapper with header/footer padding and content max-width.

ExpandableOverflow.title: Expandable overflow box
ExpandableOverflow.description: Overflow-clamped container with Show More / Show Less toggle button.

SquareActionButton.title: Square action button
SquareActionButton.description: Versatile Steam action button supporting primary/secondary variants, square mode, and flex-grow.

SteamAvatar.title: Steam avatar
SteamAvatar.description: Native Steam user avatar frame with online/in-game status indicator.

RouterHistoryStore.title: Router history store
RouterHistoryStore.description: Steam's routing store. m_history is set after Gaming Mode renders its router.

VRDashboardBarSmallButton.title: VR dashboard bar button
VRDashboardBarSmallButton.description: Small button of the SteamVR dashboard bar.

SteamIcons.description: Steam's icon registry: one icon component per readable name, such as Clock, Settings or User.
